title: 渔夫漂流记

checks.name: Bridge construction uses the real A runtime and starts paused at port
one bridge Update advances B's clock and A's world by the same delta
B clock keeps raw dt while A simulation applies its own frame clamp
large dt forces the B return pause before A can simulate that frame
multiple pause reasons stop both layers until the final reason resumes
manual pause is a named B clock reason and coexists with UI pauses
drop requires a selected copied position and spawns a 20-second world item
throwing farther than twelve meters rejects the handoff without losing the item
invalid drop selection clears the prior target and receiver reentry stays single-flight
all four B inventory items become real A drops with category, effect and TTL
exact thirty-meter fishing cast works and anything beyond it is rejected
net includes its eight-meter boundary and a single cast catches only one fish
hidden fish remain selectable and the nearest of several candidates is caught
empty-water casts receive a valid token and repeated completion only charges once
fishing prechecks require sea access, forty stamina and one free inventory slot
B fishing failures run before the A fish selector
single-flight and cancellation leave fish, stamina and inventory untouched
fishing charge and partially failed delivery roll back player and fish state
stale targets and a pause at completion reject without partial costs
recognition accepts twenty meters, rejects farther points and reads immutable coordinates
moving A fish and ship state cannot alter the B-only save snapshot
new run resets B discovery and A temporary fish while preserving fixed objects and ship
new-day world refresh waits for save success and retry is idempotent
successful load restores saved boat speed and refreshes A before one callback
offline load fails explicitly without calling a cloud adapter
Scene starts one B HUD over A renderer and shows offline status without legacy HUD
Scene ticks B once, gates pointer input immediately and records the sea pointer drop target
Scene offline store returns a clear error and never touches cloud or auto-loads
Scene Stop releases five subscriptions, renderer, HUD and UI exactly once
